name: Marble Tobiano
blurb: Tobiano gone streaky and angular - hair-thin veins on a minimal horse, broad blocky zones on a heavily marked one, and nothing at all unless it is homozygous.

expressions.name: Marble Tobiano
expressions.description: A tobiano that never learned to make a round patch. At its most minimal it is a set of hair-thin white veins running vertically and diagonally down from the topline, translucent enough that the coat reads through them, with a narrow line down the face. At its most extensive it is blocky zones eight inches and more across, fully opaque, with sharp defined edges. In between it flows in body-contoured curves at a few inches wide. It only does this when homozygous; a single copy leaves a horse barely distinguishable from an ordinary one, which is how the whole thing stayed hidden for so long.

layers.name: angular white running down from the topline

expressions.name: Coloured Marble Tobiano
expressions.description: The same veining in a colour the line carries rather than in white. Fully recessive: it takes two copies, and a single copy beside the white allele shows white. It never gives blue eyes, whatever the white form does.

layers.name: angular white running down from the topline, in colour

expressions.name: Marble Tobiano carrier
expressions.description: A single copy is not expressed - barely noticeable, and easily mistaken for an ordinary horse.
